whyItMatters: Without an HSTS max-age, browsers will not enforce HTTPS for future visits, so SSL-stripping downgrades stay possible.
actions: Send Strict-Transport-Security with a long max-age on HTTPS responses.
Enable includeSubDomains only after confirming every affected subdomain supports HTTPS.
Re-run a passive DAST scan to confirm the directive is observed.
verification: A new passive DAST scan observes an effective HSTS max-age on the target.
